---
applyTo: "docs/product/**"

# Product documentation instructions

- Link each requirement to an identifiable user outcome and acceptance criteria.
- Separate approved scope from proposals, assumptions, future options, and deferred work.
- Respect collector privacy, accessibility, ownership, media rights, and the equal dignity of inexpensive/obscure titles.
- Never conflate physical copy price paid with a market valuation or make value the primary achievement measure.
- Keep MVP small, explicitly identify non-goals, and record dependencies and approval gates.
